counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Lotus Orb}} and {{I|Linken's Sphere}} will block Dismember.

counter_texts.blink: {{I|Blink Dagger}} is not the best choice, but can be useful to quickly dodge a hook.

counter_texts.pipe: {{I|Glimmer Cape|30px}} and {{I|Pipe of Insight|30px}} both reduces Pugna's damage output considerably.

counter_texts.blink: {{I|Blink Dagger|30px}} is great versus Pugna as he hates being jumped on because of his extremely fragile nature.

counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb|30px}} can be used to reflect Life Drain and Decrepify.
counter_texts.nullifier: {{I|Nullifier|30px}} can be used to dispel Decrepify.

counter_texts.cyclone: {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity|30px}} dispels Decrepify and can be used to dodge Nether Blast.

counter_texts.blade_mail: {{I|Blade Mail}} can reflect all her nukes, especially Sonic Wave.
counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} silences her, preventing her from escaping or releasing her magic burst. It can later be upgraded to {{I|Bloodthorn}}, which allows anyone to make short work of her.
counter_texts.rod_of_atos: {{I|Rod of Atos}} prevents Queen of Pain from escaping or initiating.
counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} have instant disables, which is Queen of Pain's worst nightmare.
counter_texts.abyssal_blade: {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} have instant disables, which is Queen of Pain's worst nightmare.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} reflects Shadow Strike back at Queen of Pain if she impulsively uses it on a hero protected by it.

counter_texts.tpscroll: {{I|Town Portal Scroll|30px}} transports the user away from Razor as he has no way to interrupt the channeling.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere|30px}} blocks Static Link and Razor has no other tools to pop it.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb|30px}} reflects Static Link, wasting its cooldown for a long time.
counter_texts.force_staff: {{I|Force Staff|30px}} and {{I|Hurricane Pike|30px}} are easy tools to break Static Link.
counter_texts.hurricane_pike: {{I|Force Staff|30px}} and {{I|Hurricane Pike|30px}} are easy tools to break Static Link.

counter_texts.silver_edge: {{I|Silver Edge|30px}} nullifies {{A|Cloak and Dagger|Riki}}, taking away half of your damage and your invisibility, making {{A|Tricks of the Trade|Riki}} halfway useless in the process. Still if you are able to detect Riki and land the Silver Edge in the first place, you are already on a great advantage.

Keep in mind that Riki's Blink Strike has 2 charges so he can instantly catch you up. Try to force into the highground, or instantly follow with other disable/escaping skills.

counter_texts.invis_sword: {{I|Shadow Blade|30px}} can be used as a mean of escape, but Riki can easily counter it with Dust of Appearance, further securing the kill.

counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar}} prevents Rubick from doing anything to a hero other than stealing spells, unless he can steal a spell that can pierce spell immunity.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} prevents Rubick from using a Spell Steal. However, Spell Steal has a very low cooldown, so Rubick may use his failed Spell Steal or any other stolen spells to break the Spellblock.

counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar}} ignores all Sand King's abilities.
counter_texts.dust: {{I|Dust of Appearance}}, {{I|Gem of True Sight}} and {{I|Sentry Ward}}s will reveal Sand King through Sand Storm.
counter_texts.gem: {{I|Dust of Appearance}}, {{I|Gem of True Sight}} and {{I|Sentry Ward}}s will reveal Sand King through Sand Storm.
counter_texts.ward_sentry: {{I|Dust of Appearance}}, {{I|Gem of True Sight}} and {{I|Sentry Ward}}s will reveal Sand King through Sand Storm.
counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} [[silence]]s, preventing Sand King from casting spells. It might as well cancel Epicenter channeling and waste its mana and putting it on cooldown without applying its effects.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} can block Burrowstrike, Sand King's only inherent disable.
counter_texts.silver_edge: {{I|Silver Edge}} will disable Sand King's Caustic Finale, weakening his damage output and waveclear.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} will reflect Sand King's Burrowstrike, making it difficult for Sand King to use it against a hero who is affected by it.
counter_texts.blade_mail: {{I|Blade Mail}} will reflect Sand King's Epicenter, which could result in possibly killing Sand King unless Sand King is debuff immune.

counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} will reflect Disruption and Demonic Purge back to Shadow Demon. Additionally, illusions of Shadow Demon created by the reflected Disruption will spawn under the control of the enemy hero who reflected it.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} blocks Disruption and Demonic Purge.
counter_texts.force_staff: {{I|Force Staff}} can save the victim if they are able to force through a cliff, to the high ground or create enough distance to retreat into a foggy area.
counter_texts.tpscroll: {{I|Town Portal Scroll}} can help the victim survive a gank attempt from Shadow Demon if he initiates with a Disruption and has no way to cancel the teleport afterward, while Shadow Poison needs time to stack up and Demonic Purge only deals damage after a lengthy delay.

counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar|30px}} nullifies Slark's nuke damage from Dark Pact and destroys the leash from Pounce.

counter_texts.ghost: {{I|Ghost Scepter|30px}} prevents Slark from attacking the holder, wasting his Pounce.
counter_texts.silver_edge: {{I|Silver Edge|30px}}'s [[break]] disables Essence Shift and cannot be removed with Dark Pact.
counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Scythe of Vyse|30px}}'s [[hex]] fully disables Slark, but the hex can be dispelled with Dark Pact.

counter_texts.blade_mail: {{I|Blade Mail|30px}} is easy to time against {{A|Lil' Shredder|Snapfire}} and {{A|Mortimer Kisses|Snapfire}}, due to their slow and gradual damage output.
counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar|30px}} can simply protect you against all of Snapfire's spells.
counter_texts.diffusal_blade: {{I|Diffusal Blade|30px}} reduces Snapfire's already low mana pool and the slow prevents her from escaping easily.

counter_texts.magic_wand: {{I|Magic Wand|30px}} and {{I|Holy Locket|30px}} will gain charges from Sniper's Shrapnel spam on lane.

counter_texts.smoke_of_deceit: {{I|Smoke of Deceit|30px}} disables True Sight from Assassinate on target.
counter_texts.invis_sword: {{I|Shadow Blade|30px}} allows enemies to sneak up on Sniper and fight him up close. {{I|Shadow Blade|30px}} can later be upgraded into {{I|Silver Edge|30px}} that can also disable {{A|Headshot|Sniper}} and {{A|Take Aim|Sniper}}, which can make Sniper struggle even against heroes he naturally counters.

counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Scythe of Vyse|30px}} will completely disable Spectre, and she rarely builds a {{I|Black King Bar}} to prevent this.
counter_texts.bfury: {{I|Battle Fury|30px}} will deal AoE damage and allow Spectre to be identified from her illusions.
counter_texts.mjollnir: {{I|Mjollnir|30px}}'s active ability can deal a lot of damage to Spectre during a team fight, as damage from both {{A|Dispersion|Spectre}} and {{I|Radiance}} will drastically increase the proc chance of Static Charge.
counter_texts.silver_edge: {{I|Silver Edge|30px}} can [[break]] both {{A|Desolate|Spectre}} and {{A|Dispersion|Spectre}}, crippling Spectre.
counter_texts.crimson_guard: {{I|Crimson Guard|30px}} blocks most of physical damage from {{A|Dispersion|Spectre}}.

counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} blocks Charge of Darkness and Nether Strike, rendering him unable to surprise nor finish off enemy heroes. And Spirit Breaker has no any way of putting in on a cooldown at all.
counter_texts.ghost: {{I|Ghost Scepter}} and it's upgrade {{I|Ethereal Blade}} prevents Spirit Breaker from right clicking and bashing affected heroes. {{I|Ethereal Blade}} can also be used to disarm Spirit Breaker, slow him down and make him more vulnerable to magical damage.
counter_texts.cyclone: {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} can be used on it's owner or Spirit Breaker to cancel Charge of Darkness and Nether Strike. Later it can be upgraded into {{I|Wind Waker}} that can do the same and which can be used to escape from Spirit Breaker.
counter_texts.rod_of_atos: {{I|Rod of Atos}} and it's upgrade {{I|Gleipnir}}, {{I|Scythe of Vyse}}, {{I|Abyssal Blade}}, {{I|Force Staff}}, and its upgrade {{I|Hurricane Pike}} are all good items against Spirit Breaker that can interrupt Charge of Darkness. {{I|Gleipnir}} can also interrupt Charge of Darkness even if Spirit Breaker is invisible, which can potentially ruin his Charge of Darkness and Shadow Blade combo.
counter_texts.skadi: Any good survivability item like {{I|Eye of Skadi}}, {{I|Heart of Tarrasque}} or even {{I|Bloodstone}} can completely eliiminate Spirit Breaker's solo ganking as a threat.
counter_texts.eternal_shroud: {{I|Eternal Shroud}} greatly weakens damage from Charge of Darkness, Greater Bash and Nether Strike, as they all deal magical damage.
counter_texts.vanguard: {{I|Vanguard}} and it's upgrades: {{I|Crimson Guard}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} can make Spirit Breaker's attacks only tickle enemies who wield them. {{I|Abyssal Blade}} can also stun Spirit Breaker even if he is debuff immune.
counter_texts.dust: {{I|Dust of Appearance}} allows enemies to have vision over Spirit Breaker, as he is prone to buying Shadow Blade to maximize effects of his Charge of Darkness.
counter_texts.manta: {{I|Manta Style}}'s illusions can be used to distract Spirit Breaker, and he has no AoE abilities to deal with them effectively.
counter_texts.heavens_halberd: {{I|Heaven's Halberd}} can prevent Spirit Breaker from right clicking and bashing, thus rendering him unable to do almost anything to enemy heroes.
counter_texts.silver_edge: {{I|Silver Edge}} can disable Greater Bash, weakening Spirit Breaker's damage output. However, it is not advised to used it for escapes as Charge of Darkness can give vision over the hero affected by it if used first.
counter_texts.diffusal_blade: {{I|Diffusal Blade}} can quickly burn all of Spirit Breaker's mana, which is really detrimental for Spirit Breaker as his mana pool is very low, it can also be used to slow Spirit Breaker down and reduce effects of Charge of Darkness and Greater Bash. Later it can be upgraded into {{I|Disperser}} which can do the same and which can also dispel it's owner from most of the disables Spirit Breaker tries to throw at them while also granting them movement speed and making them immune to slows.
counter_texts.nullifier: {{I|Nullifier}} can dispel Bulldoze and ruin any of Spirit Breaker's escape attempts with {{I|Wind Waker}}, as he is prone to buying {{I|Wind Waker}}.

counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} (and its upgrade {{I|Bloodthorn}}) counters Storm Spirit, not only making him completely helpless but also dealing additional damage. Consider buying this on heroes that build a standard orchid and enjoy attacking at the same time.
counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} will stop a Storm Spirit from doing anything for 3.5 seconds, giving allies enough time to nuke a Storm Spirit down or lock him down further.
counter_texts.rod_of_atos: {{I|Rod of Atos}}'s and {{I|Gleipnir}}'s long range [[root]] abilities will cause difficulty for a Storm Spirit when trying to escape/initiate as he cannot use Ball Lightning while affected.
counter_texts.gungir: {{I|Rod of Atos}}'s and {{I|Gleipnir}}'s long range [[root]] abilities will cause difficulty for a Storm Spirit when trying to escape/initiate as he cannot use Ball Lightning while affected.
counter_texts.aeon_disk: {{I|Aeon Disk}} is a superb item for supports who want to be able to survive Storm Spirit's initiation.

counter_texts.boots_of_bearing: {{I|Boots of Bearing}} makes allies in a large area ignore Upheaval's slow for a brief period, allowing them to escape from it.
counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} silences Warlock, which is bad for him as he needs to use abilities to be impactful.
counter_texts.diffusal_blade: {{I|Diffusal Blade}} removes mana from Warlock with each attack. Considering the high mana costs of his abilities, it could leave him with no mana for casting them.
counter_texts.cyclone: {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} can stop Warlock from casting Upheaval or interrupt it, which can then allow the carrier's team to escape or get close to deal damage.
counter_texts.blink: {{I|Blink Dagger}} allows the carrier to escape from Upheaval or get close to Warlock to disrupt it, and perhaps kill him as he has no escape abilities.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} reflects Fatal Bonds and Shadow Word back at Warlock if he impulsively uses them on a hero affected by it.

counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} will prevent running away with {{A|Shukuchi|Weaver}} or {{A|Time Lapse|Weaver}}. It can be blocked by {{I|Linken's Sphere}}, however.
counter_texts.dagon: {{I|Dagon}}'s high magical burst damage can be used to finish off Weaver before he can use {{A|Time Lapse|Weaver}} to save himself, it also has no cast time and it can be used to pop {{I|Linken's Sphere}}.
counter_texts.abyssal_blade: {{I|Abyssal Blade}} and {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} provide additional hard lockdowns against Weaver.
counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Abyssal Blade}} and {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} provide additional hard lockdowns against Weaver.
counter_texts.shadow_amulet: {{I|Shadow Amulet}} and any of its upgrades: {{I|Glimmer Cape}}, {{I|Shadow Blade}} and {{I|Silver Edge}}'s invisibility can be used to neutralize The Swarm beetles.
counter_texts.gungir: {{I|Gleipnir}} can be used to root Weaver even when he is under effects of {{A|Shukuchi|Weaver}}.
counter_texts.ward_sentry: {{I|Sentry Ward}} in the early game will stop the advantages of Shukuchi and a {{I|Gem of True Sight}} in the late game is recommended against any invisible hero.
counter_texts.vanguard: {{I|Vanguard}} and its upgrades: {{I|Crimson Guard}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} will mitigate damage taken from The Swarm.
counter_texts.ghost: {{I|Ghost Scepter}} and {{I|Ethereal Blade}} makes the enemy immune to anything Weaver tries to throw at it's owners, and his only way of dealing magical damage is with {{A|Shukuchi|Weaver}}. This forces Weaver to consider buying either {{I|Nullifier}} to dispel ethereal state or {{I|Revenant's Brooch}} to attack ethereal units.
counter_texts.ethereal_blade: {{I|Ghost Scepter}} and {{I|Ethereal Blade}} makes the enemy immune to anything Weaver tries to throw at it's owners, and his only way of dealing magical damage is with {{A|Shukuchi|Weaver}}. This forces Weaver to consider buying either {{I|Nullifier}} to dispel ethereal state or {{I|Revenant's Brooch}} to attack ethereal units.

counter_texts.monkey_king_bar: {{I|Monkey King Bar}} gives accuracy that allows it's owner's attacks to bypass Windrun's evasion.
counter_texts.rod_of_atos: {{I|Rod of Atos}}, {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} prevents Windranger from escaping with Windrun.
counter_texts.cyclone: {{I|Rod of Atos}}, {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} prevents Windranger from escaping with Windrun.
counter_texts.abyssal_blade: {{I|Rod of Atos}}, {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} and {{I|Abyssal Blade}} prevents Windranger from escaping with Windrun.
counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}}, it's upgrade {{I|Bloodthorn}} and {{I|Scythe of Vyse}} can greatly reduce Windranger's performance due to her relying heavily on her skills for any tactical advantage. Bloodthorn also grants [[true strike]], bypassing Windrun's evasion.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} works against Focus Fire and Shackleshot.
counter_texts.nullifier: {{I|Nullifier}} is exceptionally useful against Windranger since it dispels Windrun.
counter_texts.heavens_halberd: {{I|Heaven's Halberd}} can disarm Windranger, allowing its owner to save himself/herself or their allies from Focus Fire's damage.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} can reflect Windranger's Shackleshot and Focus Fire back to her if she impulsively uses it on a hero protected by it.
counter_texts.blade_mail: {{I|Blade Mail}} reflects Windranger's physical damage and goes through Windrun, exposing her vulnerability to physical damage.

counter_texts.dagon: Items that deal magical damage like {{I|Dagon}}, {{I|Spirit Vessel}}, {{I|Wind Waker}}, {{I|Meteor Hammer}}, {{I|Overwhelming Blink}}, {{I|Gleipnir}}, {{I|Mjollnir}}, {{I|Radiance}}, {{I|Revenant's Brooch}} and {{I|Ethereal Blade}} will damage through Cold Embrace, especially when amplified with {{I|Veil of Discord}}.
counter_texts.ethereal_blade: {{I|Ethereal Blade}} can be cast on ally under Winter's Curse effect wasting most of its duration.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} will easily block any attempt to initiate with a Winter's Curse.
counter_texts.revenants_brooch: {{I|Revenant's Brooch}} will allow heroes reliant on basic attacks to have their next five attacks deal magical damage, and thus, ignore Cold Embrace's protection, making Winter Wyvern weak even against heroes she naturally counters.
counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar}} will cause it's wielder immune to be taunted by Winter's Curse unless if they are targeted directly by the spell, which may be useful to lock down key carries for a few critical seconds (e.g. a {{H|Sven}} that has just activated his ultimate and Black King Bar and is about to wreak havoc on your team). Additionally, Arctic Burn's and Splinter Blast's debuffs will not work.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} will render Winter's Curse very useless when activated since Winter Wyvern relies on taunting enemies heroes with Winter's Curse, reflecting it back at Winter Wyvern and ruining her ganking attempts with it.

counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar}} protects against Paralyzing Cask's stun and Maledict's damage.
counter_texts.sphere: {{I|Linken's Sphere}} blocks Paralyzing Cask on impact.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb}} reflects Paralyzing Cask back at Witch Doctor.
counter_texts.cyclone: {{I|Eul's Scepter of Divinity}} is able to cancel the channeling of Death Ward. It can also be used to dodge Paralyzing Cask.
counter_texts.vanguard: Armor items/abilities are best for mitigating damage from {{A|Death Ward|Witch Doctor}}. Damage Block from items/abilities such as {{I|Vanguard}} DO NOT reduce Death Ward damage however, and evasion is ineffective due to Death Ward's inherant bonus accuracy.

counter_texts.diffusal_blade: {{I|Diffusal Blade|30px}} can burn Wraith King's mana quickly, preventing him from Reincarnating, until Wraith King picks up Aghanim's Shard.
counter_texts.manta: {{I|Manta Style|30px}} and {{I|Illusionist's Cape|30px}} are a problem to Wraith King due to his single-target abilities and lack of mobility.
counter_texts.illusionsts_cape: {{I|Manta Style|30px}} and {{I|Illusionist's Cape|30px}} are a problem to Wraith King due to his single-target abilities and lack of mobility.
counter_texts.demonicon: {{I|Book of the Dead|30px}} summons can burn Wraith King's mana as well, preventing him from Reincarnating.
counter_texts.sheepstick: {{I|Scythe of Vyse|30px}} disables Wraith King for a good 3 seconds for him to get focus fired when defending.
counter_texts.spirit_vessel: {{I|Spirit Vessel|30px}} reduces the effectiveness of his self sustaining lifesteal making it harder for him to tank area damage.
counter_texts.skadi: {{I|Eye of Skadi|30px}} keeps him distant when acquired by a ranged capable hero and reduces his lifesteal abilities.
counter_texts.bfury: {{I|Battle Fury|30px}} and {{I|Mjollnir|30px}} deal area damage to wipe out skeletons.
counter_texts.mjollnir: {{I|Battle Fury|30px}} and {{I|Mjollnir|30px}} deal area damage to wipe out skeletons.
counter_texts.heavens_halberd: {{I|Heaven's Halberd|30px}} allows the user to dodge and disarm Wraith King's physical attacks when he commits to a chase.
counter_texts.ghost: {{I|Ghost Scepter|30px}} defends against Wraith King's physical attacks but not entirely safe from magical damage Wraithfire Blasts. It must be used as a counter attack instead of last resort.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: {{I|Lotus Orb|30px}} reflects Wraithfire Blast back to Wraith King.
counter_texts.shivas_guard: {{I|Shiva's Guard|30px}} reduces Wraith King's lifesteal capabilities while also slowing him down.

counter_texts.magic_stick: Arc Lightning and Lightning Bolt have very low cooldowns, which will provide plenty of charges for {{I|Magic Stick}} or {{I|Magic Wand}}.
counter_texts.cloak: The magic resistance from {{I|Cloak}}, as well as it's upgrades, {{I|Hood of Defiance}} and {{I|Pipe of Insight}}, will greatly reduce the effectiveness of Zeus's abilities since they are all magical. Notice that these items have separate cooldowns and stack their magic resistance bonuses, so don't hesitate to buy a Pipe and another Hood on top if one of them is not enough. Also more than one person buying a Pipe is sometimes useful, keep in mind though that the actives don't stack.
counter_texts.black_king_bar: {{I|Black King Bar}} is Zeus' worst enemy.
counter_texts.orchid: {{I|Orchid Malevolence}} silences and amplifies the damage Zeus takes, hitting him right in his weak spots (being very dependent on spells and being a very fragile Hero).
counter_texts.blade_mail: {{I|Blade Mail}} will return the damage Zeus deals. At the start of a fight, the percentage-based damage of Static Field can be especially harmful to Zeus.
counter_texts.diffusal_blade: As an intelligence hero with a big mana pool and low armor, {{I|Diffusal Blade}} deals a lot of damage against him. The slow also heavily cripples his already low movement speed.
counter_texts.heart: {{I|Heart of Tarrasque}} makes it very hard to deal serious damage with magical nukes only.
counter_texts.lotus_orb: Lightning Bolt is so useless since enemy build item {{I|Lotus Orb}}. With {{I|Lotus Orb}}, Zeus can't move slightly with Ligtning Bolt spamming abilities.
